styleLock.direction: airy dawn-lit sheer-mesh bedding commerce, built on transmitted light through a pop-up dome net and an arched aperture graphic system rather than on oatmeal soft-focus bedroom styling or caramel colour-block editing
styleLock.backgroundSystem: three fields only across the set: a dawn bedroom with a limewash wall in mist #F4F8F7 over a pale matte micro-cement floor #E4EAE8 with one real bed and one nightstand as scale anchor; clean graphic panels on mist #F4F8F7 closed by a single arched-top aperture card whose curve echoes the dome arc of the net, hairline rules in #2C7A6B and 1px leader lines; and one deep petrol night panel #0E2A30 reserved for the problem screen, lit only by a 2700K bedside lamp pool; every card keeps a 28px radius on its rectangular corners and one clean copy zone per screen, never busy decor
styleLock.lightingSystem: one low right-rear directional daylight key around 5800-6200K that visibly transmits through the sheer mesh, rims the frame arc and throws a long crisp soft-edged shadow to camera left on the floor; gentle bounce fill off the limewash wall so the mesh interior stays readable; only the night screens swap to the single 2700K practical while the shadow direction stays consistent; never flat frontal wash, never double shadow directions, never hotspot glare on the piping
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte micro-cement platform #E4EAE8, limewash plaster wall, smooth bedding in #F4F8F7 with real fabric drape and wrinkle weight, matte stoneware nightstand, powder-coated frame tubing with a soft satin sheen exactly as supplied; the mesh itself is the hero surface and is always a true semi-transparent sheer with an even fine weave, visible background through it, real light transmission and zero moiré, never a solid opaque sheet or a smoke-veil film
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif family only; Chinese in-image copy always wrapped in 「」 and kept short as generic placeholders, headline 30-42pt, sub-line 16-20pt, label 11-14pt, per-screen text budget under 50 characters, one thin letter-spaced English kicker as a small graphic element; copy set in pine ink #16302C on light fields and knocked out in mist #F4F8F7 on the petrol field; no serif, handwritten, retro or cartoon face
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline single-weight pictograms stroked 1.5px in #2C7A6B inside outline-only circles, dashed motion arcs to read airflow and barrier, solid #E06A3B step dots as the only numerals, 1px leader lines to product parts, maximum six labelled elements per screen; no filled tag cards, no 3D badges, no glossy seals, no certificate photos

cool temperature; the campaign palette styles only backgrounds, cards, icons and copy while the product keeps its own supplied piping, ruffle, zipper tape, hem print and frame finish exactly as in the reference image; one low right-rear 5800-6200K daylight key that transmits through the sheer mesh, rims the frame arc and casts one long soft shadow to camera left, consistent across the set; hairline 1.5px pictograms in #2C7A6B inside outline-only circles, dashed motion arcs, solid #E06A3B step dots, 1px leader lines, maximum six labelled elements per screen;
